roleTitle: Senior Technical Program Manager, Platform Reliability
jobDescription: Our company provides a cloud data-warehouse service to about 2,000 business customers. The Senior Technical Program Manager runs cross-team programs on platform reliability, such as region expansion and disaster-recovery testing, keeps the integrated plan and dependency map, chairs the weekly program review with engineering managers and reports status to the VP of Engineering. The role requires at least two years at senior technical program manager level, or an equivalent level documented by a previous employer, and experience running programs that span at least five engineering teams.
requirements: Has at least two years at senior technical program manager level, or an equivalent documented level.
Runs cross-team programs spanning at least five engineering teams with an integrated plan and dependency map.
Chairs a weekly program review with engineering managers and tracks risks to closure.
Reports program status to engineering leadership.
Plans and runs disaster-recovery tests with service teams.

evidence.text: Senior Technical Program Manager, Vantor Data Cloud (March 2023 to August 2026): ran the second-region expansion program across nine engineering teams, keeping the integrated plan and the cross-team dependency map in the planning tool.
Chaired the Tuesday program review with the engineering managers, tracking each risk with an owner and a closure date in the program's RAID register.
Sent a fortnightly status report to the VP of Engineering with milestone status, top risks and the decisions needed from leadership.
Technical Program Manager, Vantor Data Cloud (January 2020 to February 2023): coordinated the move of the build system to a new CI service across four teams.
Took part in planning the annual failover exercise, collecting runbooks from the service teams and booking the test windows.

Work sample: an anonymised dependency map and milestone plan from the second-region expansion program, showing the nine teams, their critical-path dependencies, slipped milestones and the decisions recorded at the program review.

HR verification note: the promotion from Technical Program Manager to Senior Technical Program Manager on 1 March 2023 was checked against the promotion letter and the payroll record supplied by Vantor Data Cloud; the senior level was held until August 2026, three years and six months in all.
Reference check summary: the engineering director at Vantor confirmed in writing that the candidate ran the second-region expansion program across nine teams and chaired its weekly program review.

propositions.text: The candidate held the Senior Technical Program Manager level at Vantor Data Cloud from March 2023 to August 2026, three years and six months in all, confirmed against the promotion letter and payroll record.
propositions.rationale: The resume gives the dated title and scope, and the HR verification note records the promotion letter and payroll check with the total.

propositions.text: The candidate ran the second-region expansion program across nine engineering teams with an integrated plan and dependency map.
propositions.rationale: The resume describes the program, the work sample shows the dependency map and the engineering director confirmed it.

propositions.text: The candidate chaired the weekly program review and tracked each risk with an owner and a closure date.
propositions.rationale: The resume states the review and the reference confirms it in writing.

gold.expectedGap: Planning and running disaster-recovery tests is only partly documented; the candidate took part in planning the failover exercise by collecting runbooks and booking test windows.
gold.expectedBoundaryNote: Keep the verified senior level and its dates and the documented program, review and reporting work; do not extend participation in failover planning into running disaster-recovery tests.
followUpTargets: Ask what the candidate personally decided or ran during the annual failover exercise and who led it.
